nom: Clinique Even Better Clinical Dark Spot Clearing Serum with Vitamin C

segments.oily: One reviewer with combination oily skin found the serum lightweight and non-sticky but saw little effect on dark spots, though it improved acne scars.
segments.sensitive: Several reviewers describe sensitive skin and report no irritation, burning, or breakouts, finding the fragrance-free formula gentle and well tolerated.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination or combination/sensitive skin describe the texture as lightweight and non-greasy, with one reporting visible dark spot improvement within three weeks.
segments.mature: Reviewers in their late 30s to 60s describe using the serum for aging, uneven tone, and fine lines, reporting smoother, brighter, more even-looking skin with consistent use.
segments.dry: One reviewer added the serum for winter dryness and reported improved texture and reduced dry patches around the nose and mouth after a month of twice-daily use.

concerns.aging: Reviewers describe using the serum for wrinkles, fine lines, and mature skin tone, reporting smoother, tighter, brighter skin and reduced fine lines with consistent use; one calls it effective for getting rid of wrinkles after a formula update.
concerns.dehydration: Several reviewers report the serum feels hydrating and non-sticky, with one noting improvement in dry patches; one dissenting reviewer felt it did not moisturize more than normal and rubbed off easily.
concerns.redness: One reviewer struggling with redness and uneven tone reports the serum reduced redness and gave a more even, glowing complexion with no irritation.
concerns.barrier: Sensitive-skin reviewers report no irritation, burning, or damage to their skin, describing the formula as gentle even during active breakouts or while using tretinoin.
concerns.spots: Most reviewers use the serum specifically for dark or sun spots; many report visible fading, lightening, or improved evenness within two to eight weeks, but a substantial minority report no change at all even after months or multiple bottles.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report the serum helped fade acne scars and post-pimple dark marks, with one specifically praising it for scars from popping pimples; one reviewer reports getting more acne after starting use.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer with combination oily skin found the texture non-sticky and manageable, and another review notes the formula is described as oil-free.

extraits.texte: I've received this item complimentary for my honest review. I've only been using this dark spot corrector for a few weeks and not every night because I also use Tretinoin… so it's hard to say if it's been making a difference or not as I'm actively breaking out. I haven't noticed it to break my skin out any more than usual though. I have very sensitive skin and this doesn't seem to do any damage. I like the simple packaging and that it's easy to apply. It applies smoothly. I don't think it's overpriced for what it is. Hopefully this will work well in conjunction with my skin routine over time. But only time will tell.

I've been using the Clinique 302 Dark Spot Clearing Serum recently. I have combination oily skin, and I find that this serum is quite lightweight, non-sticky, and easy to apply. I've been using it for three weeks now, but I haven't seen much effect yet, especially on my dark spots, i don't see any change at all. However, it works well on acne scars, especially new ones, It's noticeablely disappearing. But I still hoping it can be effective for my dark spots.

extraits.titre: Works great on my sensitive skin!
extraits.texte: I've been using the Clinique Dark Spot Serum twice a day, applying it on my face before my moisturizer, and it has quickly become a staple in my new skincare routine. It's been perfect for targeting my sun damage and dark spots, and I've noticed a visible improvement in my skin's overall tone. I love that it's fragrance-free, making it gentle even for sensitive skin, and its lightweight texture absorbs easily without feeling heavy or greasy.

I was really surprised how much I like this serum. I am very picky with skincare and have spent years perfecting my routine. I added this step in the winter hoping it would help with dryness and was impressed with it's performance. I applied it twice daily for a month and noticed visible improvement to my skin texture and tone. It also helped with dry patches around my nose and mouth. The texture of the serum is silky and medium viscosity, I prefer the the thick consistency in the winter but will look for thinner products in the summer. The bottle also dispenses evenly every time, the packaging is very lux. My skin tone looks more even than it did a month ago. I will purchase another bottle when this runs out, and continue using through the fall and winter months. Over all, I would definitely recommend this serum. I received this product for free for an honest review.

extraits.titre: Serum provides lit from within glow and reduced redness
extraits.texte: I've been using this product for the past 3 weeks and began to notice a difference about 10 days in. I usually struggle with redness, uneven skin tone and dryness. This serum has provided a "lit from within" glow to my complexion, improved radiance and a more general evenness to my skin tone with no redness or irritation. Overall impressed with this product, the packaging is super cute and look forward to buying more from this line. Great serum! Incentivized review.

For all skin types, 100% fragrance free, oil free and allergy tested, this serum promises to reduce dark spots and a more brilliant skin and it delivers! I used for good 3 weeks and I can see the difference! Worked great on my combination/sensitive skin. I applied twice a day before my moisturizer and sunscreen (super important), 2 pumps and massaged all over my face. Great value for the quality! I'd totally recommend.

extraits.titre: Not as good as the old formula
extraits.texte: I have been using Even Better Dark Spot Corrector or Clearing Serum for years and this new formula does not work nearly as well as the old one. It does not seem to fade my dark spots at all. So disappointed that after all these years that I have to look for another product that works.
